|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Once during your deploy phase, ▼ A New Secret Base, one artillery weapon, or one card with 'Hoth' in its game text (except a creature). Your artillery weapons at same and related sites are considered 'powered' and are forfeit +2.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[General Carlist Rieekan (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Your artillery weapons at same and related sites are powered and forfeit +2. During your deploy phase, may deploy one A New Secret Base, an artillery weapon, or a non-creature card with “Hoth” in game text from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' removed “Once during your deploy phase, ▼ A New Secret Base, one artillery weapon, or one card with 'Hoth' in its game text (except a creature).”; “considered 'powered'” → “powered”; removed “are”; added “During your deploy phase, may deploy one A New Secret Base, an artillery weapon, or a non-creature card with “Hoth” in game text from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
